name: argo-rollouts-conversion-agent
document:
apiVersion: kagent.dev/v1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: argo-rollouts-conversion-agent
  namespace: kagent
spec:
  description: Converts Kubernetes Deployments to Argo Rollouts for easier canary and blue-green deployments.
  type: Declarative
  runtime: go
  skills:
    - conversion
  examples:
    - description: Converts a standard Deployment to an Argo Rollout
  prompts:
    - Explore how to convert your Deployments to Argo Rollouts with our conversion agent.

name: helm-agent
document:
apiVersion: kagent.dev/v1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: helm-agent
  namespace: kagent
spec:
  description: Manages Helm package management and release lifecycle operations such as listing, installing, upgrading, uninstalling releases, managing Helm repositories, and troubleshooting Helm issues.
  type: Declarative
  runtime: go
  skills:
    - helm
  examples:
    - description: Lists all Helm releases in the cluster
  prompts:
    - Manage your Helm releases more effectively with the Helm Agent.

name: k8s-agent
document:
apiVersion: kagent.dev/v1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: k8s-agent
  namespace: kagent
spec:
  description: Expert AI specializing in Kubernetes cluster operations, troubleshooting, and maintenance including diagnostics, resource management, and security auditing.
  type: Declarative
  runtime: go
  skills:
    - cluster-operations
    - troubleshooting
    - maintenance
  examples:
    - description: Diagnoses issues in Kubernetes clusters
  prompts:
    - Use this agent for expert AI assistance in Kubernetes management and operations.

name: kgateway-agent
document:
apiVersion: kagent.dev/v1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: kgateway-agent
  namespace: kagent
spec:
  description: Specializes in Kubernetes Gateway API and kgateway for installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and integration with Helm and Envoy proxy.
  type: Declarative
  runtime: go
  skills:
    - gateway-api
    - kgateway
  examples:
    - description: Installs or upgrades the kgateway and its CRDs
  prompts:
    - Manage your Kubernetes Gateway API and kgateway with expert guidance from this agent.

name: observability-agent
document:
apiVersion: kagent.dev/v1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: observability-agent
  namespace: kagent
spec:
  description: Specializes in Kubernetes observability with capabilities for Prometheus monitoring, PromQL query generation and execution, Grafana dashboard management, and cluster/application health insights.
  type: Declarative
  runtime: go
  skills:
    - observability
    - prometheus
    - promql
    - grafana
  examples:
    - description: Generates PromQL queries for monitoring
  prompts:
    - Use this agent for advanced Kubernetes observability and metrics analysis.

name: promql-agent
document:
apiVersion: kagent.dev/v1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: promql-agent
  namespace: kagent
spec:
  description: Specializes in generating PromQL queries from natural language, explaining, debugging existing queries, and providing Prometheus data model best practices.
  type: Declarative
  runtime: go
  skills:
    - promql
  examples:
    - description: Generates PromQL queries based on natural language input
  prompts:
    - Get help generating and debugging PromQL queries with this agent.

name: retrieval-agent
document:
apiVersion: kagent.dev/v1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: retrieval-agent
  namespace: kagent
spec:
  description: Data agent operating on vector and graph stores for semantic search and relationship queries, ingesting Kubernetes declared objects and maintaining detailed object graphs.
  type: Declarative
  runtime: go
  skills:
    - data-ingestion
    - semantic-search
    - relationship-query
  examples:
    - description: Semantic search over Kubernetes object manifests and graph queries on object relationships
  prompts:
    - Use this agent for advanced data ingestion and retrieval in Kubernetes environments.

name: agentgateway
document:
HelmRelease agentgateway in namespace agentgateway-system.
- Chart reference: OCIRepository named agentgateway in flux-system namespace.
- Depends on agentgateway-crds HelmRelease in the same namespace.
- Install settings: create namespace true, reconciliation interval 1h.
- Release name: agentgateway.
- Values: enables the inference extension.
- Status: installed and ready.
- Inventory: includes ServiceAccount, Roles, RoleBindings, Service, Deployment resources related to this release.

name: agentgateway-crds
document:
HelmRelease agentgateway-crds in namespace agentgateway-system.
- Chart reference: OCIRepository named agentgateway-crds in flux-system namespace.
- Install options: create namespace true, CRDs install strategy CreateReplace.
- Reconciliation interval: 1h.
- Release name: agentgateway-crds.
- Status: installed and ready.
- Inventory: includes CRD resources managed by this release.

name: agentregistry-inventory
document:
HelmRelease agentregistry-inventory in namespace agentregistry
- apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2
- Chart reference: agentregistry/agentregistry
- ReleaseName: agentregistry-inventory
- Status: installed
- Namespace creation and 1-hour reconciliation enabled
- Values:
  - authentication disabled
  - image tag: 0.5.18
- Manages Kubernetes resources: ServiceAccount, ClusterRole, ClusterRoleBinding, Services, Deployment, CustomResourceDefinitions related to agentregistry

name: kagent
document:
HelmRelease kagent in namespace kagent.
- Chart reference: OCIRepository named kagent in flux-system namespace.
- Depends on kagent-crds HelmRelease in the same namespace.
- Install settings: create namespace true, reconciliation interval 1h, kustomize post-render patch adds version label 0.10.1.
- Release name: kagent.
- Values: components and agents configured; default provider OpenAI with API key reference.
- Status: installed and ready.
- Inventory: ServiceAccounts, Roles, RoleBindings, Secrets, ConfigMaps, PVCs, Deployments related to this release.

name: kagent-crds
document:
HelmRelease kagent-crds in namespace kagent.
- Chart reference: OCIRepository named kagent-crds in flux-system namespace.
- Install settings: create namespace true, CRDs install strategy CreateReplace.
- Reconciliation interval: 1h.
- Release name: kagent-crds.
- Status: installed and ready.
- Inventory: CustomResourceDefinitions for MCPServers, Agents, ModelConfigs, ToolServers managed by this release.

name: llm-d-embedding
document:
HelmRelease llm-d-embedding in namespace llm-d.
- Chart: llm-d-modelservice v0.3.17 from HelmRepository llm-d-modelservice in flux-system namespace.
- Install settings: create namespace true, reconciliation interval 1h.
- Release name: llm-d-embedding.
- Values: CPU accelerator, decode container with llama-server image, replica 1, custom resource mount and model URI, monitoring disabled.
- Status: installed and ready.
- Inventory: ServiceAccount and Deployment related to this release.

name: llm-d-pool
document:
HelmRelease llm-d-pool in namespace llm-d.
- Chart reference: OCIRepository inferencepool in flux-system namespace.
- Depends on llm-d-embedding release in the same namespace.
- Install settings: create namespace true, reconciliation interval 1h.
- Release name: llm-d-pool.
- Values: inferenceExtension with monitoring mostly disabled, resource requests and limits; inferencePool with modelServer label selector and port; provider none.
- Status: installed and ready.
- Inventory: ServiceAccounts, ConfigMaps, Roles, RoleBindings, Deployments, InferencePool CRD related to this release.

name: neo4j
document:
HelmRelease neo4j in namespace neo4j.
- Chart: neo4j v2026.7.1 from HelmRepository neo4j in flux-system namespace.
- Install settings: create namespace true, reconciliation interval 1h.
- Release name: neo4j.
- Values: security procedures and plugin settings; community edition; resource requests CPU and memory; data volume 5Gi with default storage class.
- Status: installed and ready.
- Inventory: secrets, config maps, services, StatefulSet related to this release.

name: phoenix
document:
HelmRelease phoenix in namespace phoenix.

name: neo4j-mcp
document:
MCPServer neo4j-mcp in namespace kagent
Image: neo4j/mcp:v1.6.0
Transport type: stdio
Port: 3000
Replicas: 1
Environment variables: NEO4J_MCP_DATABASE=neo4j, NEO4J_MCP_PASSWORD=(redacted), NEO4J_MCP_READ_ONLY=false, NEO4J_MCP_TELEMETRY=false, NEO4J_MCP_URI=bolt://neo4j.neo4j:7687, NEO4J_MCP_USERNAME=neo4j
Status: valid, deployed, ready

name: qdrant-mcp
document:
MCPServer qdrant-mcp in namespace kagent
Image: ghcr.io/den-vasyliev/abox/qdrant-mcp:0.4.0
Transport type: stdio
Port: 3000
Replicas: 1
Environment variables: EMBEDDINGS_BASE_URL=http://llama-cpp-embeddings.llama-cpp:8090, QDRANT_COLLECTION=abox-nomic, QDRANT_URL=http://qdrant.qdrant:6333
Status: valid, deployed, ready

name: qdrant-mcp-official
document:
